newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut market in bullish mood.
newsitem.headline: Beirut market in bullish mood.

text.p: Leading shares sustained pre-weekend gains on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday and brokers said the market opened on bullish trade.
Bank of Beirut rose to $3.8125 from $3.6875. A block of 130,000 shares traded on the floor at $3.6875.
"Bank of Beirut was today's surprise. I see it rising further. I see it at $4," one broker said.
Demand for BOB was 167,550 against a supply of 94,398 shares -- all of which were executed.
Banque Audi maintained its all-time high level at $23.125, keeping its total rise above flotation price at over 50 percent.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was unchanged at $17.625 in strong demand.
The LIBX bank index rose 1.12 percent to 150.8. The BLOM general index rose 1.28 percent to 942.77 while the LISPI general index rose 0.95 percent to 89.26.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.75 from $10.5. Demand for the share was 226,714 against a supply of 83,770 on the first fixing. Only 31,456 shares were traded.
Solidere B shares were unchanged at $10.75. Demand for the shares stood at 219,560 on the first fixing against a supply of 25,655 -- some 12,700 of which were only traded.
"I expect the shares to stay around these levels and consolidate at around $10.75 - $11," the broker said.
Of the four industrial firms, pipemaker Eternit rose to $2.03125 from $1.9375 on turnover of 5,000 shares. Demand for the share was 74,000 while supply was 8,200.
A block of 12,000 Eternit shares traded on the floor at $2.03125.
There was no trade in Ciments Blancs or tilemaker Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 375,496 shares for a value of $2,330,908 against 240,164 shares for a value of $1,858,718 on Friday.
